xiaozhi_voice 的路径：

**回收站中：**
- `~/.local/share/Trash/files/tswatch/xiaozhi_voice/`
- `~/.local/share/Trash/files/tswatch.10/xiaozhi_voice/`
- `~/.local/share/Trash/files/tswatch(1)/tswatch/xiaozhi_voice/`
- `~/.local/share/Trash/files/tswatch-1/tswatch/xiaozhi_voice/`

**当前项目中：**
- `~/myself/test/bes-watch-common-clean/bes-watch-common/rtos/apps/examples/tswatch/xiaozhi_voice/`

主要文件包括：
- `xiaozhi_main.c` (回收站版本 92KB，当前版本 88KB，有差异)
- `mcp_server.c` / `mcp_server.h`
- `xiaozhi_audio.c` / `xiaozhi_audio.h`
- `xiaozhi_ota.c` / `xiaozhi_ota.h` / `xiaozhi_ota_tls.c`
- `xiaozhi_ws.c` / `xiaozhi_ws.h`
- `xiaozhi_voice.h`
- `xiaozhi_probe_frames.h`

回收站版本的 `xiaozhi_main.c` 比当前版本大 (92KB vs 88KB)，`res` 目录也有更新。需要我对比具体差异吗？
